subject: Capacity sprint: dedicated slab sizing + vendor ETA sync
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@nimbuscloud.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Dedicated slab sizing for ND-2027-09 (initial ask)

Hi Xiao / Nimbus team,

Thanks for taking the time earlier. We're moving to a firm onboarding window for the ND-2027-09 deal (ACME), and want to align on two items so we can finalize the internal commitment:

1) Dedicated slab sizing — we expect an initial committed pool of 120 A100-equivalent GPUs (8-node slab topology) for month 1, ramping to 320 by the end of month 4.
2) Vendor/OEM lead times — we need an updated ETA for physical GPU SKUs and a clear cloud-burst backfill option while OEMs ship.

Can you confirm whether Nimbus can provide:
- An updated quote that separates OEM-fulfilled capacity vs. cloud-burst credits
- Lead-time table per SKU, including customs/port assumptions for US West
- Any recommended staged-delivery cadence (e.g., 50/150/120) that you can commit to with dates

Attachments: none in this message — we'll follow with a sizing table.

Ideal response target: EOD Fri 17 Sep so we can feed numbers into the contract. If you need more information on our routing/fallback requirements I can loop in infra.

Thanks,

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0128

Ben — thanks for the clear ask. Quick answers/clarifying Qs below.

What we can provide:
- Updated quote (attached as Nimbus_Quote_v1.pdf) split by SKU and a separate line item for cloud-burst credits.
- Preliminary lead-time table per SKU (see inline below) — these are estimate windows from our OEM partners, not firm until PO.

Estimated OEM lead times (US West transit):
- A100-80GB variant: 10-14 weeks from PO
- H100-80GB variant: 18-22 weeks from PO (constrained lane)
- 4U chassis (integrated nodes): 8-12 weeks

Clarifying questions:
1) Do you need full physical delivery for month-1 (i.e., 120 GPUs in racks) or is a hybrid approach acceptable (60 physical + 60 cloud credits)?
2) What is your preferred customs/warehousing plan (we can route to our Seattle crossdock vs. customer DC)?

Attachments: Nimbus_Quote_v1.pdf (15KB, application/pdf), OEM-leadtime-table.xlsx (8KB, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

We can tighten windows after PO and can run a staged-delivery commitment with a 30% deposit. DocuSign ready once terms line up.

— Xiao Li

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@nimbuscloud.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Dedicated slab sizing for ND-2027-09 (initial ask)

Got it — thanks Xiao. Short answers and an inline sizing snapshot to make the ask concrete.

Answer to Q1: hybrid acceptable for month-1. We prefer 80 physical + 40 cloud-burst credits for month-1 to hit latency SLOs for the first tranche of customers.
Answer to Q2: please route to Nimbus crossdock (Seattle) — Redwood will arrange final on-site carrier and customs.

Sizing snapshot (month by month committed slab targets):
- Month 1 (onboard): 80 physical GPUs + 40 cloud credits (total 120 eq)
- Month 2: 160 physical + 80 cloud credits (240 eq)
- Month 3: 240 physical + 80 cloud credits (320 eq)
- Month 4+: 320 physical committed

Can you produce a staged-delivery calendar that maps these month targets to firm ship windows (we need calendar dates to populate the contract SLA section)? Also confirm whether a 30% deposit is sufficient to lock OEM queue priority.

Thanks — attaching our short onboarding checklist (inline) so ops has less back-and-forth:
- Delivery to Nimbus crossdock (Seattle)
- On-site staging window: 3 business days after receipt
- Rack+network integration slot (Redwood infra) — target within 5 business days of staging

Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Xiao / Nimbus team — looping in CS/Onboarding (Marissa) and platform PM (Karthik) so we can get an operational commitment. Two asks from Redwood leadership to finalize the order: 

1) A staged-delivery calendar with firm shipment windows (calendar dates) for each month target Ben outlined. We need dates we can include in the contract SLA.
2) OEM lead-time contingency: provide an explicit fallback plan if H100s slip beyond 22 weeks — specifically, a short list of compatible substitute SKUs and estimated performance delta (p50 latency impact).

Proposed mutual action plan (MAP):
- Nimbus to provide staged calendar + revised quote (separate lines for physical vs cloud credits) by EOD Tue 21 Sep.
- Redwood to sign PO with 30% deposit within 48 hours of receiving calendar.
- Nimbus to confirm queue priority with OEMs within 7 business days of PO.

Marissa — please prep onboarding availability matrix (rack dates) for the week of Oct 11–15.

Thanks,

Grace O'Connor

- Staged calendar (proposed):

  * Ship window 2 (additional 80): target ship 2027-10-25 (arrive by 2027-11-01)

Next steps:
1) Confirm the staged calendar above by close of business today and we'll issue DocuSign for the PO with a 30% deposit clause.
2) We'll confirm OEM queue priority within 3 business days of PO but cannot guarantee until deposit posts.
